registration.validator_notes: Affine alignment verified against Harvard-Oxford subcortical atlas mask.

spatial.subfield_mapping_notes: The ingested 3D asset represents the macroscopic unsegmented left hippocampus (Cornu Ammonis CA1-CA4 + dentate gyrus within one contiguous boundary). Distinct internal subfield parcellation boundaries are not resolved in this macroscopic surface mesh and will be integrated during subsequent subfield segmentation phases.

boundaries.superior: Temporal horn of lateral ventricle (ventral floor) and amygdaloid complex (anterosuperior)
boundaries.inferior: Subiculum and parahippocampal gyrus (separated by hippocampal fissure)
boundaries.anterior: Amygdaloid complex (separated by uncal recess of temporal horn)
boundaries.posterior: Splenium of corpus callosum, tapering into subsplenial gyrus / indusium griseum
boundaries.medial: Ambient cistern, wing of ambient cistern, and midbrain crus cerebri
boundaries.lateral: Collateral eminence of temporal horn of lateral ventricle

relationships.notes: Dentate gyrus interlocks with cornu ammonis, receiving perforant path inputs and projecting mossy fibers to CA3.
Transition zone between 3-layered archicortex of CA1 and 6-layered parahippocampal neocortex.
Located immediately anterosuperior to the hippocampal head.
Hippocampus proper is archicortex (3 layers) and does not receive a Brodmann number. Area 28 (Entorhinal cortex) is an adjacent paralimbic area providing primary cortical input via perforant path.

primary_functions: Consolidation of declarative episodic and semantic memory representations
Spatial navigation and allocentric cognitive mapping (place cells)
Contextual fear conditioning and extinction memory retrieval
Negative feedback inhibition over Hypothalamic-Pituitary-Adrenal (HPA) stress axis

rdoc_associations.finding_summary: Hippocampal-entorhinal circuitry mediates the binding of disparate cortical representations during episodic encoding and retrieval.
Ventral (anterior human) hippocampus projects to basolateral amygdala and medial prefrontal cortex to resolve contextual safety vs. threat ambiguity.

associated_disorders.pathophysiological_role: Replicated volumetric reduction on MRI meta-analysis. Chronic glucocorticoid elevation and neuroinflammation associate with CA3/CA1 dendritic arbor shrinkage and suppressed adult neurogenesis in animal models; human post-mortem findings indicate reduced neuropil density rather than massive neuronal loss.
Reduced bilateral hippocampal volume associated with deficit in contextual discrimination, predisposing to failure of fear extinction and intrusive re-experiencing in non-threatening environments.

Anterior hippocampal metabolic hyperactivity observed in resting fMRI/PET. Hypothesized parvalbumin-positive GABAergic interneuron NMDA hypofunction disinhibits CA1/subiculum projection neurons, driving excess downstream striatal dopamine release via nucleus accumbens pathway (Grace model).

receptor_target.downstream_signaling_cascade: Inhibits adenylyl cyclase, activates GIRK potassium channels -> membrane hyperpolarization; modulates neuroplastic CREB/BDNF cascades.
receptor_target.predominant_cellular_expression: Pyramidal neurons in CA1 and granule cells in Dentate Gyrus

pharmacology_mappings.lamina_distribution: High density in stratum radiatum and stratum lacunosum-moleculare of CA1

clinical_drug_interactions.functional_consequence: Increases synaptic 5-HT availability, driving enhanced postsynaptic 5-HT1A signaling over chronic administration.
Direct partial agonism at postsynaptic hippocampal 5-HT1A receptors combined with SERT inhibition.

pharmacology_mappings.therapeutic_relevance: Key molecular transducer mediating cellular neuroprotective and neuroplastic effects of long-term antidepressant pharmacotherapy.
pharmacology_mappings.side_effect_vulnerability: Transient initial nausea and anxiety modulation via raphe feedback.

stimulation_parameters.intensity_description: 1.5x to 2.5x initial seizure threshold determined by dose titration

neuromodulation_protocols.local_induced_field_description: Generates a broad, distributed transcranial electric field traversing the temporal lobes and medial temporal structures bilaterally.

downstream_network_effects.clinical_mechanism_description: Induces robust transient volumetric expansion and synaptogenesis in bilateral hippocampus/dentate gyrus, accompanied by robust antidepressant response and retrograde memory retrieval side-effects.

neuromodulation_protocols.primary_clinical_indication: Severe Treatment-Resistant Depression with Psychotic Features or Acute Suicidal Emergency

regulatory_clearances.formal_indication_label: Severe major depressive episode associated with major depressive disorder or bipolar disorder, catatonia, or severe treatment-resistant depression in patients 13 years of age and older
regulatory_clearances.guideline_reference: APA Task Force on ECT (2001) / FDA 2018 Special Controls

adverse_effect_profile: Transient retrograde and anterograde episodic memory impairment
contraindications: Unstable intracranial mass with elevated intracranial pressure

clinical_pearls: Sommer sector (CA1 sector) has high metabolic demand and dense NMDA receptor distribution, making it the most vulnerable brain region to hypoxic-ischemic arrest.

Korsakoff syndrome impairs declarative recall due to degeneration of the mammillary bodies and anterior thalamic nuclei, disconnecting hippocampal fornix output without primary hippocampal destruction.

neurological_deficits.syndrome_or_lesion_name: Bilateral Mesial Temporal Resection (Patient H.M. / Severe Herpes Simplex Encephalitis)
neurological_deficits.clinical_manifestation: Dense, irreversible anterograde amnesia for all new episodic and semantic information, with preserved working memory span, remote autobiographical memories, and intact motor procedural skill acquisition.
neurological_deficits.bedside_examination_test: Delayed recall of 3 or 5 unrelated words after a 5-minute and 10-minute interval with intervening cognitive tasks.

imaging.normal_morphological_appearance: Well-demarcated internal gray matter core bounded superiorly by CSF in temporal horn and inferiorly by white matter of subiculum.
imaging.key_radiological_landmarks: Coronal slice oriented perpendicular to temporal lobe axis: Identifies digitationes hippocampi in head, alveus, and fimbria.

pathological_imaging_manifestations.sequence_finding: Atrophy with loss of internal laminar architecture on coronal 3D T1, accompanied by FLAIR hyperintensity.
pathological_imaging_manifestations.radiological_significance: Most frequent epileptogenic lesion in drug-resistant temporal lobe epilepsy.

technical_artifacts_or_pitfalls: Volume averaging with choroid plexus in temporal horn
Susceptibility artifact from petrous temporal bone pneumatization

provenance.source_authority: Terminologia Anatomica 2 (FIPAT) / Snell's Clinical Neuroanatomy 8th Ed
provenance.provenance_notes: Anatomical identity and boundaries defined according to FIPAT TA2. 3D geometry candidate identified in Z-Anatomy; production mesh processing scheduled for Phase 1.

evidence_claims.claim_statement: Adults with major depressive disorder demonstrate robust bilateral hippocampal volume reduction on structural MRI compared with healthy controls, most pronounced in recurrent or early-onset illness.
evidence_claims.outcome_measure: Hippocampal volume difference in mm3 (Cohen's d = -0.14)
limitations_identified: Small effect size at single-patient level; cannot serve as individual diagnostic biomarker
Potential confounding by antidepressant treatment exposure and illness duration

primary_citation.title: Subcortical brain volume abnormalities in 2028 patients with major depressive disorder from the ENIGMA MDD working group

evidence_claims.claim_statement: Suppression of adult hippocampal subgranular zone neurogenesis by stress and its restoration by antidepressants is a primary causal driver of depressive episodes and clinical recovery.
evidence_claims.outcome_measure: BrdU+ / DCX+ newborn neurons in dentate gyrus and behavioral immobility time
evidence_claims.certainty_summary: Preclinical and theoretical hypothesis; human post-mortem stereological evidence remains deeply contested.
limitations_identified: Extent and persistence of adult human hippocampal neurogenesis remains contested in post-mortem stereology (e.g., Sorrells et al., 2018 vs. Boldrini et al., 2018)
Ablation of neurogenesis in rodents does not consistently induce depressive phenotypes without severe stress

contradictory_evidence.opposing_finding_summary: Human hippocampal neurogenesis drops sharply in children to undetectable levels in adults.

citation.title: Human hippocampal neurogenesis drops sharply in children to undetectable levels in adults

primary_citation.title: Neurogenesis in the adult human hippocampus

evidence_claims.claim_statement: Bilateral resection or destruction of the medial temporal lobe (hippocampus and parahippocampal gyrus) causes severe, irreversible loss of recent memory encoding with preserved remote memories and intellectual faculties.
evidence_claims.outcome_measure: Formal neuropsychological recall and retention testing
evidence_claims.certainty_summary: Oxford CEBM Level 4: Case series of 10 surgical bilateral medial temporal lobe resection patients demonstrating severe irreversible anterograde declarative memory loss.
limitations_identified: Patient H.M. lesion included substantial portions of adjacent amygdala and entorhinal cortex

primary_citation.title: Loss of recent memory after bilateral hippocampal lesions
primary_citation.journal_or_book: Journal of Neurology, Neurosurgery, and Psychiatry

references.title: The Human Central Nervous System, 4th Edition
